'''Squick''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] who, by c. [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], had became a member of a group of [[Believers]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Genarius]], under the command of [[Alina Impeveri]].

==Personality and traits==
Despite not being a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]], Squick wanted to become a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. He wore [[Jedi apparel/Legends|Jedi robes]] that he had looted from a Jedi corpse, and obtained a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], which he learned how to use.
